title: Roasted Cherry Tomatoes with Basil

items.item: medium to large cherry tomatoes, stemmed (about 4 cups)

items.prep: stacked 4 to 5 at a time, rolled up, and thinly sliced

instructions: Place a rack in the center of the oven. Preheat the oven to 500°F.

Place the tomatoes in the smallest pan that will hold them comfortably. Drizzle the olive oil over them. Rub the oil over the tomatoes and pan. Sprinkle with the salt. Roast for 10 minutes. Shake the pan to move the tomatoes around.
Add the basil and toss lightly. Serve warm.
